calls.statement: SELECT calendar_date, holiday_name, is_trading_day, fiscal_period_label FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND (NOT is_trading_day OR is_public_holiday)

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) ORDER BY receipt_id, line_no, sales_line_id LIMIT 20

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) AS dup_rows, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(f.etl_loaded_at), max(f.etl_loaded_at), sum(f.net_amount) AS net, count(DISTINCT f.store_key) AS stores
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (
  SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) AS rn
  FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'),
sd AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(s.net_amount) AS net_dedup FROM s JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=s.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=s.product_key
  WHERE rn=1 AND st.store_id<900 AND st.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1),
sr AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(s.net_amount) AS net_raw FROM s JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=s.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=s.product_key
  WHERE st.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1),
rp AS (
  SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_before, sum(returns_net) AS rpt_ret, sum(net_sales) AS rpt_net, count(*) AS days
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT rp.store_id, rp.days, sd.net_dedup, sr.net_raw, rp.rpt_before, round(sd.net_dedup-rp.rpt_before,2) AS diff_dedup, round(sr.net_raw-rp.rpt_before,2) AS diff_raw
FROM rp LEFT JOIN sd USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN sr USING (store_id) ORDER BY abs(coalesce(sd.net_dedup,0)-rp.rpt_before) DESC, 1

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, st.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) AS rn
        FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21') f
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.rn = 1 AND st.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
rets AS (
  SELECT r.return_date AS business_date, st.store_id, -r.refund_net AS net_sales
  FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY return_line_id ORDER BY return_ts_utc) AS rn FROM fact_return_line
        WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21') r
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE r.rn = 1 AND st.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
net AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) AS net_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets) GROUP BY 1),
trading AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, count(*) AS trading_days
  FROM dim_store st
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
  WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900 AND d.is_trading_day
    AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.calendar_date)
    AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.calendar_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
  GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) AS rpt_net, count(*) AS rpt_days FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY n.net_sales / t.trading_days DESC) AS rnk, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.region, round(n.net_sales,2) AS net_sales, t.trading_days,
       round(n.net_sales / t.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day, round(n.net_sales - c.rpt_net,2) AS diff_vs_ctl, c.rpt_days
FROM net n JOIN trading t USING (store_id) JOIN ctl c USING (store_id) JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rnk
